title: BOOT-04 full-vision provider research and cost comparison checkpoint

changes.description: Read the full blueprint/checklist/548-leaf register and researched current official provider prices and recovery limitations before proposing services. Director requests cost-tier comparison, primarily North America and up to 50 concurrent players.

Fresh existing-container baseline passed doctor, static/documentation verification, five bootstrap tests and read-only PostgreSQL connectivity in RUN063. Public source retrievals are research observations, not deployed-service qualification.

Prepare a dated full33-group provider research proposal, six explicit quoted-rate cost fixtures, 35 retrieval records (34 successful plus404), service/DNS/secret inventory, recovery/retention/capacity assumptions and future runtime prerequisites. Current indexes, feature/map, backlog, decisions, qualification and handoff distinguish proposal from implemented code.

Render/PG18/Cloudflare/Resend/Sentry versus Railway metered PG18 and AWS synchronous RDS/Fargate alternatives researched from current official sources. No provider selection or purchase/deployment. Unknown domain/age/region/account/tax/usage quotes remain explicit; unsupported zero-loss/50-player claims are rejected.

RUN064 passed static full-scope/cost/official source-byte/SKU assertions. Source URL404/missing-file extraction and missing ss utility probe are preserved as failed research/probe attempts, not passing acceptance; corrected preservation uses proc TCP tables. No ad hoc tooling installed.

Documentation gate RUN065 correctly rejects added scope X04/X06/X07 in fields restricted to original leaf requirement IDs. Correct only draft change/feature references to affected R30 leaves; retain X01-X07 scope in cost/proposal/task narratives without altering the validator or548-ID register.

RUN066 passes corrected docs/static gates, current/full-history known-secret scans, unchanged executable/config/dependency bytes, owner-only ignored private files, actual proc TCP-table no-listener proof and formatting. Finalized scope is the research checkpoint only; BOOT-04 design acceptance remains in progress.
RUN067 passed final research checkpoint docs/config/history/log/format consistency after finalizing only completed research; no deployed/load/recovery/device acceptance inferred.

limitations: BOOT-04 remains in progress: Director ceiling/recovery/provider/domain/age/operations and final exact regional/account/domain/tax quotes are open. No new infrastructure is deployed or purchased.

AWS NAT allowance comes from an official Ohio example, not a verified us-east-1 SKU; unpriced meters remain explicit. Railway averages are not fixed reservations; Render standby is asynchronous.
